title: Check OS Version
description: Display Linux distribution and OS version information.
script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

if [[ -r /etc/os-release ]]; then
    . /etc/os-release
    echo "Distribution: ${PRETTY_NAME:-unknown}"
    echo "ID: ${ID:-unknown}"
    echo "Version: ${VERSION_ID:-unknown}"
else
    uname -a
fi
